name: spick-dashboard
description: Shows who is working now (lane, model) above the prompt, and a /spick pane with switches (routing, review, gate, guard, lanes, band), lane totals, local quota and recent turns. The switches shape the per-prompt triage checklist, which carries a keyword Hint line per prompt. The gate and the guard are the mod's only two interventions: the gate sends a hinted verdict the main session kept back once at stop time; the guard caps the main session's own source edits at 3 files per turn and sends a turn that edited source without running a check back once at stop time.
